description: Live-oracle FCMP++/PQC spend KAT: the exact bytes a running shekyld accepted (consensus verify) and then connected in a block. Sibling to pruned_tx_hash_parity_v1.json, which is hand-built, deterministic and daemon-free and binds Rust to C++; this one binds both to a chain. Neither subsumes the other — do not consolidate them. Regenerate with SHEKYL_CAPTURE_SPEND_KAT=1 and SHEKYLD_BIN set, running engine::regtest_e2e::e2e_fcmp_spend_accepted_by_daemon --ignored.
